tools.name: PhotoCraft
tools.subtitle: Adobe Photoshop Alternative
tools.description: Professionelle Bildbearbeitung, Ebenen, Masken, Filter, Pinsel und zerstörungsfreies Arbeiten in reinem Rust.
tools.command: if [ -x target/release/photocraft ]; then ./target/release/photocraft "$@"; else cargo run --release -p photocraft -- "$@"; fi
